name: Horse Expert
summary: Craft and wear a monocle, then look at a tamed horse, donkey, mule or llama to see its health, speed, jump height and (for pack animals) storage slots. Helps choose breeding stock.

new_content.name: Monocle
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shaped: gold nuggets in a plus shape (top, left, right, bottom) around a glass pane in the center
new_content.notes: Tooltip: 'Wear it and look at a mount to see all statistics!'

mechanics.title: Stats display
mechanics.description: Shows health in hearts, speed in blocks/second, jump height in blocks, and storage slots, with min/max ranges. Requires a tamed mount by default (configurable). Llamas show extra info.

editor_notes: Equip slot not confirmed (jar ships trinkets data; verify whether the pack includes Trinkets or the monocle goes in the head slot). Config is TOML; edit via /config showfile horseexpert.
